emulate_int8_histogram_quantize: quantize a PyTorch tensor to int8 using a histogram observer for scale and zero point calculation
emulate_int8_channel_quantize: quantize a PyTorch tensor to int8 using per-channel min-max observer for scale and zero point calculation
